details:
Add group specific blocked list feature and settings (Both in-game) to how it operates:

 - Core feature adds blocked group list for the user to block

    a specific group which is added to their group blocked list so that they:

        - Don't receive group invites from that group.

        - Don't see public group worlds by that specific blocked group.

            (This one above is very much needed, as when a user is banned from a group, 

            they can still attempt to join the world, and are instantly kicked which is annoying.)

        - Automatically: Mute/Hide avatar/Block users associated with a blocked group.

 - Add blocked group settings so that they can change how a blocked

    group is allowed to interact with them by toggling interactions as mentioned above.

The features here would be greatly appreciated, most bad actors (trolls) typically will join groups that have bypassed report filters and are at that moment, non-suspended groups, but will be when they receive enough reports, this can help users retain some power by lowering the amount of unsavory users they run into on a normal basis, by stopping bad actors from even interacting with them before they join a world.
title: Comprehensive user utility for blocking groups
